name: Linear Model Analysis for Plane Reproduction
definition: An analysis of a linear model $f(x; w) = w^T x$ to justify the loss function's ability to converge to the signed distance function of a plane when the input data is sampled from a plane.
summary: Linear Model Analysis for Plane Reproduction theoretically justifies converging to a plane's signed distance function using a data-dependent linear model, avoiding fixed grid memory costs.
